terms_note: Not live-verified: built from the task page and the huggingface_hub client source (read 2026-11-02), no recorded call. The route is POST https://router.huggingface.co/hf-inference/models/<model> with {inputs, parameters}, answered with raw image bytes. The task page does not print the URL, it comes from the client source. Free accounts have no included credits, so a call needs a PRO plan or purchased credits. hf-inference is billed by compute time, so the price is unknown. Other providers behind the router (fal-ai, replicate, nscale) use their own request formats and are not used here. Each model has its own license. Check Paradox's and Steam's rules for AI-generated mod assets before publishing.

cost.proxy_of: none: hf-inference bills compute time at the hardware price

models.notes: The hf-inference text-to-image model named in the docs. The width and height limits are not documented, the 64 multiple and about 1 MP cap are conservative assumptions. No references or edits on this route.
